items.headline: Store owner stops a runaway school bus with 18 kids aboard
items.caption: Ebro Ahmed, 27, climbed in after the driver had a seizure. Every child was safe.
body: In St. Paul, Minnesota, 27-year-old Ebro Ahmed saw a school bus roll past his store while the driver was having a seizure.
He climbed aboard, put the bus in neutral, set the parking brake and called for help. None of the 18 children were hurt, and the driver is expected to be OK.
He credits the TV show Grey's Anatomy for helping him stay calm, and he was given a $1,000 award.

items.headline: Amazon deforestation falls to its lowest in almost 40 years
items.caption: Clearing in Brazil's Amazon is down nearly 42% from the same period last year.
body: Deforestation in Brazil's Amazon has fallen to its lowest level in almost four decades, according to the latest data.
That is a drop of nearly 42% compared with the same period last year.

items.headline: Women in Nigeria plant 150,000 mangroves to heal their coast
items.caption: Women-led groups are replanting mangroves in a polluted part of the country.
body: In a polluted region of Nigeria, women-led groups are replanting mangrove forests.
One trainee and a dozen other women have planted more than 150,000 mangrove saplings.
